title: Failure-triage evaluation boundaries
description: Run from the checkout. Set TRIAGE_PROOF_OUT to a new directory. All transport fixtures are explicitly non-live and cannot enable the pilot.

proof.intent: Exercise the real evaluation CLI's offline, key, price, budget, timeout, rate-limit and response rejection paths; retain known usage on invalid replies, release pretransport reservations, and assert no live provider calls or eligible fixture results.

v2.intent: Prove admitted v2 selection, no reference/control data in serialized SDK input, no retries, live guards and correlated-family reporting without external transport.

pilot-evidence.intent: Validate the immutable pilot prerequisite through the real verifier CLI; reject absent, tampered and handwritten gates without provider calls.

navigation-workflow.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json node --import tsx scripts/failure-triage/workflow-navigation-cli.mts seal-advice scripts/failure-triage/navigation-cases.v1.json "$TRIAGE_PROOF_OUT-navigation-plan.json" && node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); if (p.hash!=="1577ac63d9bb38817f7642b0ef2b27301723e399708338025cd7948227300ccf" || p.cases.length!==8) process.exit(1)' "$TRIAGE_PROOF_OUT-navigation-plan.json" && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json node --import tsx --test scripts/failure-triage/workflow-navigation-cli.test.mts scripts/failure-triage/workflow-navigation-runner.test.mts
navigation-workflow.intent: Seal the frozen synthetic navigation corpus, then drive the real offline CLI through worker-plan sealing, blind export and scoring. Fixture receipts cover completed and rejected worker paths; no provider call is possible.
